verdict.rationale: The homepage claims you can "Prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents in seconds," which suggests prompt-driven creation and editing of automations. The docs also say workflow errors can be debugged with AI. Neither item explicitly says that workflows themselves are generated or edited from a natural-language prompt. Missing for 10: documented prompt-to-workflow generation, AI-driven editing of existing workflow steps, in-depth docs on the feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
